title: Lambun da aka yi wa Alƙawari a Alfijir
intro: A cikin shiru kafin fitowar rana, an yi wani shiri a ɓoye. Gado mai albarka ya shirya don girbi, amma an ƙudura aniyar nisantar da kowace 'ya'yan itace daga waɗanda ke cikin buƙata. Da safe, komai zai yi kama da wanda ba a saba gani ba, kuma za a saka darasi a cikin rassan da suka yi baƙi ga duk wanda ya yi tunani.
clues: Mun gaji wani lambu mai bunƙasa kuma muka yi alƙawarin girbin dukkan 'ya'yan itacen da ke cikinsa don kanmu.
Mun yi rantsuwar fita da sassafe yayin da talakawan da suka nemi rabonsu har yanzu suna barci.
Mun cire duk wani keɓancewa daga rantsuwarmu kuma muka hana wa mabukata haƙƙinsu ba tare da mun ce idan Allah Ya so ba.
Mun fita muna raɗa wa junanmu don kada wani talaka ya shiga gonarmu a wannan rana.
Mun yi tunanin kanmu muna da cikakken ikon tattara komai da kuma hana duk wani mai girbi ya ɗauki rabo.
Mun farka muka ga lambunmu ya lalace da daddare, an yi baƙi kamar an girbe shi, muka ce an hana mu kuma mun tuba.

arabic: إِنَّا بَلَوْنَـٰهُمْ كَمَا بَلَوْنَآ أَصْحَـٰبَ ٱلْجَنَّةِ إِذْ أَقْسَمُوا۟ لَيَصْرِمُنَّهَا مُصْبِحِينَ
verse: Indeed, We have tried them as We tried the companions of the garden, when they swore to cut its fruit in the [early] morning (68:17)
